task: Predict SMAD4 mutation status in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma. Classes: wildtype vs. mutant. On H&E, distinguishing clues for SMAD4-altered tumors may include poorer differentiation, infiltrative growth, necrosis, and more aggressive stromal-invasive patterns, although morphology can be subtle.

classes.0: SMAD4 wildtype tumor with less overtly aggressive morphology and relatively preserved gland-forming differentiation.
classes.1: SMAD4 mutant tumor showing more poorly differentiated, infiltrative, and aggressive-appearing pancreatic adenocarcinoma features.
